verdict_reason: Removing the contact-address refusal case is correct, but the fullyAnswered helper seeds only a port and a consignor, so its name mispredicts what it builds.

todos.issue: The helper fullyAnswered (lines 65-69) suggests a notification with every answer filled in. It seeds only portOfEntry and a consignor, and the tests pass only because beforeEach stubs readiness with configureReadyForCheckYourAnswers(SET_ID, () => true) (line 96). Its callers (lines 122, 131, 138, 148, 158, 168, 176, 184, 209) read as if the notification were complete. This PR removed the fullyAnswered({ contactAddress }) case, so this file is in scope.
todos.fix: Must: the helper's name says what it seeds: a known port of entry and a valid copied consignor, with readiness supplied by the stub. One way: rename it to validPortAndConsignor (or answersThatPassTheirRules) and update every caller.
